# origincloud_compute_image (Resource)

A project's own image, which an instance's boot volume can be created from.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `block_devices` (Attributes List) The image's disks, each created for an instance launched from it. Changing it replaces the image. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--block_devices))
- `description` (String) What the image holds, as you describe it.
- `project` (String) The project the image is in. Changing it replaces the image.
- `root_device` (String) The device name of the disk the image boots from: one of the `block_devices`' `device`. Changing it replaces the image.
- `zone` (String) The zone the image is in. Changing it replaces the image.

### Optional

- `default_user` (String) The account an instance launched from the image logs in as, unless the launch names another: a POSIX user name of at most 32 lowercase letters, digits, underscores and hyphens, starting with a letter or an underscore, and not `root`. `cloud` when left empty. Changing it replaces the image.
- `tags` (Map of String) Labels of your own, at most 50. The `origin:name` tag is the name the console shows.

### Read-Only

- `architecture` (String) The CPU architecture it boots on. One of `X86_64`.
- `creator` (String) The principal that created the image, such as `user:<id>`.
- `id` (String) The image's resource name, the same as `name`.
- `name` (String) The image's resource name.
- `platform` (String) Its operating system family. One of `LINUX_UNIX`.
- `state` (String) Where it is in its lifecycle. One of `AVAILABLE`.
- `urn` (String) The image's URN, the identifier access policies and the audit log use.

<a id="nestedatt--block_devices"></a>
### Nested Schema for `block_devices`

Required:

- `device` (String) The device name the disk appears under on every instance launched from the image: `vda` to `vdz` but `vdc`, unique within the image.
- `size_gib` (Number) The disk's size in GiB, at least the snapshot's.

Optional:

- `source_snapshot` (String) The protected snapshot the disk is created from, in the image's project and zone; an empty disk when left empty.
